sourceTitle: Memoirs of Carwin the Biloquist (A Fragment)
description: "Memoirs of Carwin the Biloquist (A Fragment)" by Charles Brockden Brown is an unfinished story published in monthly installments between 1803-1805. Young Carwin discovers he can perfectly mimic any voice through ventriloquism.
